title: The Wonder of Ponder
description: Adds Create's pondering system to TLOTD mods. Hold down the ponder key to see a 3D visualization of how blocks and items from our mods interact with each other.
body:
![The Wonder of Ponder Logo](https://tlotd.net/minecraft/mod/the-wonder-of-ponder-title.png)

_"Have you ever wondered how the televison or the radio works in [TLOTD](https://modrinth.com/mod/tlotd)? Or do you want to know how you change the phase of a traffic light in [Roads 'n' Vehicles](https://modrinth.com/mod/roads-n-vehicles)? Wonder no longer 'cuz there's a ponder!"_

![The traffic lights ponder for the traffic lights from Roads 'n' Vehicles. Showing the player the correlation between the redstone strength the controller block recieves and the traffic light above.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/c57h4E1J/images/c5ef52870f0e79dbd08a51038a59f31912b33339.png)

# About

[![TLOTD Icon](https://tlotd.net/minecraft/mod/tlotd-made.png)](https://tlotd.net)
[![Isla_Nublar Icon](https://tlotd.net/minecraft/mod/isla_nublar_made.png)](https://isla-nublar.com)

Adds [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)'s pondering system to TLOTD mods (Without requiring Create). With this mod, you can just hold the ponder key to see a 3D visualization of how blocks and items from our mods interact with each other.

# Mod Loaders
| Mod Loader | Dependencies |
| --- | --- |
| [![Fabric Icon](https://tlotd.net/minecraft/mod/fabric.svg)](https://fabricmc.net) | [![Fabric API Button](https://tlotd.net/minecraft/mod/fabric_api.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) |
| [![Quilt Button](https://tlotd.net/minecraft/mod/quilt.svg)](https://quiltmc.org) | [![Quilted Fabric API Button](https://tlotd.net/minecraft/mod/quilted_fabric_api.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/qsl) |
| **❌ INCOMPATIBLE with FORGE or NEOFORGE ❌** | **❌ CRASHES with SINYTRA CONNECTOR ❌** |

## Supported Projects

| Supported Project | Project Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [![TLOTD Logo](https://tlotd.net/wiki/mc-mod/assets/tlotd.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/tlotd) | **[TLOTD](https://modrinth.com/mod/roads-n-vehicles)** | _Adds pondering to a few devices like the radio, relevision, keycard reader and a few more._ |
| [![Roads 'n' Vehicles Logo](https://tlotd.net/wiki/mc-mod/assets/roads-n-vehicles.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/roads-n-vehicles) | **[Roads 'n' Vehicles](https://modrinth.com/mod/roads-n-vehicles)** | _Adds pondering to traffic lights and their controller._ |

## Q & A
Q: Is this project open source?
A: Yes the full source code is available over on Github.

Q: Am I allowed to include this mod in my modpack?
A: Sure, just credit it somewhere.

Q: The Mod is not available in my native language, what can I do?
A: You could help the Project by providing a translation over on Github.
